$comment: Featuring markers (SPEC.md R5.2, R7.2, R8.3). titleMarkers / titleProducer are the only unbracketed markers recognised on the title side (R8.3). ASCII lowercase. A marker matches a whole whitespace-delimited word (case-insensitive). 'bracketOnly' markers only count at the start of a bracket group. A leading `w/` on a tracklist line is a different thing: layered-words.json (R13.13).
